relations.quote: It is built inside a [Finite linear network with roles and frames](linear-network-roles.md).

Let $\mathcal F=(\mathbb Q^h)^{\otimes 3}$, a space built from the [tensor product of vector spaces](tensor-product-of-vector-spaces.md) of three copies of $\mathbb Q^h$, of dimension $m=h^3$ (the letter $m$ changes meaning here).

symbols.name: ground set size
symbols.meaning: The number of elements of the ground set $[h]$, here $100$.
symbols.quote: Let $[h]=\{1,\dots,h\}$ be the ground set, with $h=100$.

symbols.name: triples
symbols.meaning: The set of three-element subsets of $[h]$.
symbols.quote: For a three-element subset $T$ of $[h]$, called a triple, $t_T$ is its indicator vector, and $\mathcal T$ is the set of all triples.

symbols.name: triple
symbols.meaning: A three-element subset of $[h]$, one of the elements of $\mathcal T$.
symbols.quote: For a three-element subset $T$ of $[h]$, called a triple, $t_T$ is its indicator vector, and $\mathcal T$ is the set of all triples.

symbols.name: indicator vector of T
symbols.meaning: The indicator vector of the triple $T$.
symbols.quote: For a three-element subset $T$ of $[h]$, called a triple, $t_T$ is its indicator vector, and $\mathcal T$ is the set of all triples.

symbols.name: triple value
symbols.meaning: The value carried by the triple $T$.

symbols.name: target triple
symbols.meaning: A second triple, used as the target or a neighbor of $T$.

symbols.name: element
symbols.meaning: An element of the ground set $[h]$.
symbols.quote: gather puts the sum of the $g_T$ with $T\ni e$ on a central wire $C_e$ for each element $e$, and scatter adds $\sum_{e\in S}C_e$ to the target $S$.

symbols.name: central wire
symbols.meaning: The central wire of element $e$, which carries the sum of $g_T$ over the triples $T\ni e$.
symbols.quote: gather puts the sum of the $g_T$ with $T\ni e$ on a central wire $C_e$ for each element $e$, and scatter adds $\sum_{e\in S}C_e$ to the target $S$.

symbols.name: auxiliary wire
symbols.meaning: The auxiliary wire for the neighbor pair $(S,T)$, carrying a copy of $g_T$.
symbols.quote: A copy of $g_T$ on an auxiliary wire $A_{ST}$ for each neighbor pair, injected back into $S$, adds $1$ exactly when $|S\cap T|=1$.

symbols.name: all-one matrix
symbols.quote: Over $\mathbb Q$, the bilinear form with matrix $I-J/9$, where $J$ is the all-one matrix, gives $\langle t_T,t_S\rangle=|T\cap S|-1$; neighbors are orthogonal.

symbols.name: label space
symbols.meaning: The tensor cube of $\mathbb Q^h$, the space containing every label.
symbols.quote: Let $\mathcal F=(\mathbb Q^h)^{\otimes 3}$, a space built from the [tensor product of vector spaces](tensor-product-of-vector-spaces.md) of three copies of $\mathbb Q^h$, of dimension $m=h^3$ (the letter $m$ changes meaning here).

symbols.name: label space dimension
symbols.meaning: The dimension of $\mathcal F$, which counts the coordinates of a label space.
symbols.quote: Let $\mathcal F=(\mathbb Q^h)^{\otimes 3}$, a space built from the [tensor product of vector spaces](tensor-product-of-vector-spaces.md) of three copies of $\mathbb Q^h$, of dimension $m=h^3$ (the letter $m$ changes meaning here).

symbols.name: index
symbols.quote: For an index $\alpha=(T_1,T_2,T_3)\in\mathcal T^3$, the label $U_\alpha$ is the line spanned by $t_{T_1}\otimes t_{T_2}\otimes t_{T_3}$.

symbols.name: label
symbols.meaning: A label, a nondegenerate subspace of $\mathcal F$; $U_\alpha$ is the label of index $\alpha$.
symbols.quote: A label $U$ is a nondegenerate subspace of $\mathcal F$.

symbols.name: label projection
symbols.quote: Give each gate or sink with label $U$ the projection $P_U$ onto $U$ along $U^\perp$, and the source of index $\alpha$ the matrix $-P_{U_\alpha}$.

symbols.name: smaller-call count
symbols.meaning: The number of smaller calls, the total rank over all edges.
symbols.quote: Let $s$, the total rank over all edges, change meaning here.

symbols.name: index count
symbols.meaning: The number of indices $\alpha$, which is $\binom h3^3$.
symbols.quote: Let $N=\binom h3^3$, the number of indices $\alpha$ (the letter $N$ changes meaning here).

symbols.name: decreasing loss
symbols.meaning: The total dimension lost on decreasing edges.
symbols.quote: Let $L$ be the total dimension lost on decreasing edges (the letter $L$ changes meaning here).
